steps.title: Define App Metadata and Configuration Settings
steps.description: Establish the application name 'Pencil Sketch Studio' and define 'com.pencilsketchstudio.app' as the target package identifier.

steps.title: Configure Gradle Build Properties
steps.description: Configure the project's 'build.gradle' specifying compileSdkVersion 34, targetSdkVersion 34, and ensure compatibility with Java 8 bytecode specifications.

steps.title: Configure AndroidManifest file
steps.description: Declare launch activities, external storage legacy options, and setup the standard hardware rendering canvas configurations.

steps.title: Design Traditional Layout UI with Layout ScrollViews
steps.description: Create 'activity_main.xml' featuring top utility bars, responsive custom canvas placeholders, bottom grade selectors, and adjustable sliders.

steps.title: Code the custom DrawingView drawing Canvas
steps.description: Program custom path handlers, layered multi-touch traversals, and canvas state management.

steps.title: Program Soft Pencil Graphite and Smudge Mask Shaders
steps.description: Add support for HB, 2B, and 6B charcoal shaders with BlurMaskFilter integrations inside 'DrawingView.java'.

steps.title: Implement Handcrafted Paper Texture and Draft Guides
steps.description: Program organic wooden speckles, line margins, and beautiful drawing grids alongside guide outline shapes (Face, Flowers, Landscapes).

steps.title: Implement Undo and Redo Touch Tracking History
steps.description: Structure individual DrawPath objects for custom track memory, allowing swift backward/forward sketching iterations.

steps.title: Connect User Activity Listeners and Lead Grade selectors
steps.description: Write listeners for Pencil Grade buttons (HB, 2B, 6B, Color) to set brush textures and widths dynamically.

steps.title: Build Dynamic Rounded Wax Color Palette Drawer
steps.description: Construct programmatically generated rounded color indicators to choose diverse color leads without inflating XML static resources.

steps.title: Integrate MediaStore Exporters for Photo Gallery Saving
steps.description: Program media content values to serialize, package, and write user drawings straight to the Gallery folder safely.

steps.title: Building Pencil Sketch Studio
steps.description: Finalize and execute the gradle assemble script to generate the APK debug binaries.
